_init_process_group_state: initialize FSDP process group state with sharding strategy and optional device mesh for hybrid sharding
_init_param_handle_from_module: create a FlatParamHandle from a fully sharded module handling device placement and parameter synchronization
_init_ignored_module_states: initialize ignored modules and parameters state to exclude specific parameters from FSDP sharding
_materialize_meta_module: materialize a module on meta device by calling reset_parameters on each submodule
_sync_module_params_and_buffers: synchronize module parameters and buffers by broadcasting from rank 0 to all ranks in the process group
